jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join Kraken’s Finance Data Eng & Analytics team within Data Platform. You’ll build trusted financial data products, using automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve the close process.

Working at the intersection of data engineering and accounting, you’ll turn complex financial data into reliable pipelines, models and automated reconciliations. You’ll use AI-assisted tools to accelerate development and investigations, keeping financial outputs tested and traceable.

 

The opportunity

  • You’ll work closely with Data Engineers, Finance and Platform Accounting to improve reporting and decision-making. Clear communication and collaboration will help you agree priorities, explain findings and drive adoption.

  • Partner with Finance to understand workflows, identify pain points and translate business needs into practical data and automation solutions.

  • Build and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups, with clear controls, monitoring and exception handling.

  • Build intuitive dashboards and visualizations that help stakeholders understand performance, investigate issues and make decisions.

  • Resolve finance data issues and reconciliation breaks with Finance, Product and Engineering, addressing root causes and communicating progress.

  • Build scalable, reliable pipelines to collect, transform and curate data from internal platforms and external systems.

  • Support the design and rollout of a trusted finance data lake, with clear definitions, ownership and quality checks.

  • Improve data timeliness, enabling near-real-time insights where they add business value.

  • Evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted automation, and prototype solutions to Finance needs that can be reliably supported in production.

 

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, working directly with Finance teams.

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including writing, debugging and maintaining production code.

  • Solid experience with Git, merge requests, and code reviews, supported by strong software engineering practices, including testing and documentation.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating pipelines and models using dbt, Spark, Airflow or comparable tools.

  • Direct experience with finance or accounting data, such as reconciliations, subledgers, cost basis or month-end close, including investigating discrepancies and validating outputs with accounting stakeholders.

  • A track record of owning pipelines end to end, making sound technical decisions and improving reliability as requirements and systems evolve.

  • Judgment and autonomy to lead complex work, navigate ambiguity and remain accountable for production outcomes.

  • Experience supporting recurring financial close activities, combined with a proactive approach to identifying manual processes and replacing them with reliable, sustainable automation.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across Engineering and Finance, explain complex technical issues, articulate financial implications, and recommend actionable solutions.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with cryptocurrency transaction data and how digital-asset activity flows into financial records and reconciliations.

  • Experience processing large volumes of financial transactions using distributed frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are seeking a skilled & hands-on Senior Security Architect for Kraken Security Labs. Kraken Security Labs provides boutique-style, deeply technical internal security consulting on current and future products.

We don't merely provide high-level guidance but indeed get deeply embedded in the different engineering teams and do not mind hands-on work.

Our projects span from classical infrastructure security projects, over cryptography, web3, and complex Rust projects, to securing our next generation of AI products.

You will work in a small, highly technical team and collaborate with teams all across the company & world.

 

The opportunity

  • Design, review & verify robust security architecture in a heterogeneous environment

  • Conduct thorough security assessments and audits of existing architectures, recommending practical improvements

  • Stay updated with latest (blockchain) security trends, threats and mitigation techniques

  • Provide expertise to our blockchain teams, ensuring secure operational practices

 

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as an IT security expert, with a strong background in application security

  • Experience in security testing diverse application

  • Experience with infrastructure security

  • Basic familiarity with security frameworks (OWASP, NIST, etc)

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively remotely work with stakeholders across the organization

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken is building a dedicated AI Compute and Infrastructure team to power the next generation of model training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation across the exchange. This team sits within engineering leadership and owns the infrastructure layer that lets Kraken run AI workloads with control, speed, reliability, and cost discipline.

The team is responsible for GPU and accelerator infrastructure, cluster operations, scheduling, model serving, observability, capacity planning, and cost-efficient compute at scale. This is the backbone that allows Kraken to train, serve, evaluate, and iterate on AI systems in-house where it matters for privacy, latency, reliability, cost, or product differentiation.

You will join a small, senior, high-impact team working directly with AI/ML researchers, platform engineers, security teams, and product teams. The mandate is simple: make Kraken's AI ambitions real by building compute infrastructure that is fast, dependable, efficient, and production-grade.

 

The opportunity

  • Own and operate GPU and accelerator clusters used for training, inference, evaluation, and experimentation, including drivers, runtimes, kernels, device plugins, node configuration, scheduling primitives, and workload isolation.

  • Design infrastructure that enables Kraken teams to run models locally on GPUs where it is strategically and economically preferable, reducing unnecessary dependency on external providers and containing compute costs.

  • Build and improve scheduling, orchestration, placement, quota management, and utilization systems across heterogeneous accelerator environments.

  • Optimize inference pipelines for latency, throughput, reliability, memory efficiency, and cost using frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, or equivalent serving stacks.

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to remove bottlenecks in training, evaluation, batch inference, online inference, deployment, and production debugging workflows.

  • Build observability for GPU utilization, memory pressure, queue depth, saturation, token throughput, request latency, failed workloads, capacity pressure, and spend.

  • Drive reliability, incident response, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident improvements for always-on AI compute infrastructure.

  • Evaluate and integrate new hardware, cloud instance families, specialized accelerators, runtimes, schedulers, and serving frameworks as the AI infrastructure landscape evolves.

  • Build tooling that makes GPU usage visible, accountable, and easier for internal teams to consume without needing to become infrastructure experts.

  • Contribute to long-term architecture decisions that balance performance, cost efficiency, scalability, operational simplicity, and production safety.

 

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with significant time spent on GPU compute, ML infrastructure, distributed systems, high-performance computing, or large-scale production platforms.

  • Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or accelerator-backed infrastructure in production or production-like environments, including scheduling, orchestration, utilization monitoring, and cost optimization.

  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals across Linux, networking, storage, containers, Kubernetes, distributed runtimes, and production debugging.

  • Experience with ML serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, TorchServe, KServe, Ray Serve, or equivalent systems.

  • Proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, debugging, integration, and operational workflows.

  • Practical understanding of performance tradeoffs across batching, concurrency, memory usage, GPU utilization, model size, latency, throughput, availability, and cost.

  • Track record of optimizing compute costs while maintaining clear performance, reliability, and availability expectations.

  • Experience building observable systems with useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, and incident workflows.

  • Comfortable working in high-stakes, always-on environments where uptime, throughput, correctness, and operational discipline are critical.

  • Clear communicator who can translate infrastructure tradeoffs for researchers, product teams, platform engineers, security stakeholders, and engineering leadership.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, high-frequency trading firm, research platform, or high-scale ML organization.

  • Familiarity with custom silicon or specialized accelerators such as TPUs, AWS Trainium, Gaudi, or similar platforms.

  • Background in capacity planning, procurement input, reserved capacity strategy, cloud accelerator economics, or GPU fleet cost management.

  • Experience with distributed training frameworks such as DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, FSDP, Ray, or equivalent systems.

  • Experience debugging CUDA, NCCL, kernel, driver, runtime, memory, networking, or low-level performance issues.

  • Experience with Rust, C++, Go, CUDA, or other systems languages used for performance-critical infrastructure.

  • Crypto, financial services, trading infrastructure, or security-sensitive production infrastructure experience.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Affiliate Specialist - Pro (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 
 

The opportunity

As an Affiliate Specialist for Kraken Pro, you will support the growth and day-to-day operations of the Kraken Pro affiliate program by identifying and onboarding new partners and by owning the operational processes that keep the program running accurately and compliantly. Key responsibilities include:

Partner recruitment:

  • Source and prospect new affiliate partners across media publishers, mobile networks, incentive sites, social network partnerships, CTV, etc.

  • Draft and send personalized outreach.

  • Manage the partner pipeline from first contact through onboarding.

  • Support partner vetting and scoring processes (for example, mobile network partner intake and evaluation).

  • Assist with go-to-market/launch coordination for new affiliate partners, briefs, newsletters, and creative asset delivery.

Affiliate operations:

  • Own day-to-day Impact.com platform administration, partner account setup, tracking link QA, and commission structure updates.

  • Support weekly, monthly reporting cycles (QuickSite, AppsFlyer, Hex exports), feeding the Pro performance dashboard and updates.

  • Monitor for compliance and fraud flags (performance benchmark violations, PID marketplace prohibitions) and escalate per policy.

  • Support invoice and payment reconciliation with acceleration partners and finance.

  • Maintain partner creative assets, records, contracts, and documentation (compliance matrix, partner type reference tables).

Cross-functional support:

  • Coordinate with agencies on day-to-day partner servicing and escalations.

  • Assist with ad hoc analysis and dashboard maintenance.

  • The program scales: support in the affiliate strategy development.

  • Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, design, martech, and analytics.

 

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, partnerships, growth marketing, or a related digital marketing field.

  • Strong written communication skills for partner outreach and relationship management.

  • Comfortable working with data.

  • Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to manage multiple partner relationships and workstreams concurrently.

  • Genuine interest in the crypto or fintech industry.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to SQL or BI tools (Hex, QuickSight).

  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact.com or similar) and attribution tools (AppsFlyer).

  • Fintech or crypto experience.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – AI Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The AI Infrastructure team builds and operates the production systems that power intelligent agents at scale. This team sits at the foundation of the agent platform, ensuring that model inference, orchestration, and execution layers are reliable, observable, and performant under real-world load.

Working closely with the Agent Systems team and broader infrastructure partners, this group owns the core primitives that enable agents to safely operate across internal systems. The environment is high-scale and high-stakes — systems serve millions of users and must meet strict reliability, latency, and correctness standards.

This is a deeply production-oriented team. Engineers here combine strong systems thinking with applied ML infrastructure experience, building in Rust and operating services where performance and failure modes matter.

 

The opportunity

  • Design and build the infrastructure layer powering AI agent systems in production

  • Develop high-performance services that handle model inference, orchestration, and execution

  • Architect scalable systems capable of supporting millions of users and high request throughput

  • Build reliable ML infrastructure and MLOps patterns for model deployment, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Define guardrails, observability, and failure handling for agent-driven workflows

  • Optimize latency, throughput, and cost across inference and orchestration layers

  • Partner closely with the Agent Systems team to translate experimental prototypes into hardened production systems

  • Contribute to foundational infrastructure decisions in a high-scale, high-impact environment

 

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating high-scale production systems

  • Strong Python skills and the ability to reason about systems performance and reliability

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, reliability engineering, and performance optimization

  • Experience operating services serving millions of users or high-throughput workloads

  • Familiarity with ML infrastructure, model serving, or MLOps in production environments

  • Experience designing observability, monitoring, and failure recovery systems

  • Strong collaboration skills working across infrastructure and applied engineering teams

  • High ownership mindset in high-stakes production environment

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Rust

  • Experience building infrastructure for agent-based or LLM-powered systems

  • Background in high-performance networking, async systems, or low-latency architectures

  • Experience with container orchestration and cloud-native infrastructure

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks and model performance monitoring at scale

  • Experience working in fast-moving 0→1 or platform-building teams

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend - Consumer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We work across web and mobile surfaces, partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Platform teams, and use experimentation, observability, and user behaviour to guide what we build next.

 

The opportunity

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality consumer-facing features across web (React) and mobile (React Native), owning the full experience from concept to production monitoring.

  • Own the full lifecycle of product work, from discovery and technical design through release, monitoring, experimentation, and iteration.

  • Drive A/B testing and experimentation strategies forming hypotheses, designing experiments, analysing results, and iterating based on data.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Mobile engineers to create coherent experiences across Kraken’s consumer surfaces.

  • Make opinionated technical decisions on framework and architecture choices (we want engineers who have strong views on things like TanStack Router vs Next.js App Router and can back them up with real experience).

  • Set the standard for high-quality code — functional correctness, accessibility, performance, and testability are non-negotiables.

  • Mentor engineers across seniority levels and contribute to a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

  • Lead and collaborate on complex cross-platform initiatives, driving alignment across web and mobile surfaces.

  • Stay ahead of the curve on React ecosystem tooling, React Server Components, concurrent features, streaming, and bring those insights back to the team.

  • Work AI-natively, we use AI tools across the full SDLC and expect engineers to have a structured, opinionated workflow, not just autocomplete.

 
 

What you bring

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

 

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

As a Senior Software Engineer in Payward Services you'll build and scale the systems that make this platform work under the hood, from real-time coordination across services to the infrastructure enterprise partners depend on to move money and assets safely, at scale, every day. We’re looking for builders who thrive in ambiguity, move quickly with ownership, and care deeply about creating robust solutions.

 

The opportunity

  • Design and implement robust Rust services and libraries that power trading, payments, and crypto experiences with a focus on reliability, performance, and user impact.

  • Write reusable, testable, and highly efficient code that scales across teams and supports revenue-critical systems without compromising safety or security.

  • Collaborate on large-scale distributed systems architecture, translating evolving product requirements into resilient, low-latency solutions.

  • Work alongside hundreds of experienced Rust engineers, contributing to a high-performance, product-driven engineering culture.

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • Proficient in writing network services or asynchronous code in Rust

  • Have a security-first mindset during system design to ensure robustness

  • Demonstrate the ability to autonomously debug issues across the stack (OS, network, application)

  • Apply a solid understanding of distributed systems and technologies, including RPC protocols, Kafka, and Event-Driven Systems, to design scalable solutions

  • Collaborate effectively with product teams to gather requirements and constraints for designing appropriate systems

  • Take complete end-to-end ownership of systems and libraries

  • Provide mentorship to other engineers while contributing to defining the technical culture

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As a Deal Lead on our Corporate Development team, you’ll be responsible for executing M&A transactions that drive our strategic vision forward. Working closely with a cross-functional team of stakeholders, you’ll lead discussions with target leadership, negotiate key terms, coordinate due diligence, identify sources of risk, and drive deals to a timely closing. You bring a deep interest across financial services, especially in the crypto industry, a deep familiarity with M&A processes, strong financial modeling and valuation skills, and the ability to work fluidly across multiple high-priority initiatives.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Contribute shaping Kraken’s M&A, venture strategy and identifying high-value opportunities

  • Drive M&A, venture investments and develop recommendations that push initiatives forward

  • Spearhead the end-to-end deal process, from initial diligence to closing

  • Articulate key value drivers and considerations for potential M&A and venture opportunities in concise deal memos; build consensus across Leadership and the wider organization

  • Oversee the development of pro forma financial models and valuation analyses

  • Coordinate the due diligence process in concert with cross-functional stakeholders

  • Build and maintain an extensive network in the crypto and financial services industry to stay on top of key trends and developments

  • Contribute to enhancing the Corporate Development function by identifying opportunities to improve processes and mentoring team members

  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

 
 

What you bring

  • 8+ years of experience in Corporate Development at a hyper-growth FinTech company or investment bank

  • Experience building pro forma financial models and valuation analyses (DCF, comparable multiples, accretion / dilution, etc.)

  • Deep familiarity with the M&A process (and venture), including legal matters and integration planning

  • Strong ability to drive consensus and coordinate process with a diverse group of cross-functional stakeholders in Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and beyond

  • An understanding of the global regulatory environment around crypto and financial services

  • Strong knowledge of and/or demonstrated curiosity for the cryptocurrency industry

  • Excellent analytical, problem solving, writing, and storytelling skills

  • Rigorous attention to detail and a reputation for “sweating the small stuff”

  • Technical background or strong knowledge of software/internet products and services

  • Strong network in crypto and / or traditional financial services markets

As a trusted partner, you will help prepare for and execute the company’s highest-priority conversations, from one-on-one meetings to Board sessions and company-wide forums.

You will report directly to the Co-CEO and work closely with the executive team and administrative staff.

This is an on-site role in San Francisco. This role requires extensive domestic and international travel with the Co-CEO.

  • Own the Co-CEO’s calendar end to end: prioritize, protect focus time, resolve conflicts, and anticipate needs before they become problems

  • Own preparation for the Co-CEO’s meetings, with briefing materials, context, and follow-ups

  • Learn the business and track company priorities, surfacing gaps, risks, and decisions that need the Co-CEO’s attention early

  • Build and run operating rhythms for the Office of the CEOs, including executive team meetings and leadership forums, and drive follow-through on action items

  • Serve as the first line of intake for requests to the Co-CEO, triaging effectively and routing to the right owner

  • Partner with functional leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to keep initiatives aligned and moving

  • Lead special projects for the Co-CEO that span teams and are critical to the company’s success

  • Travel with the Co-CEO and other executives, handling logistics, scheduling, and day-of coordination

  • Manage logistics for Board meetings, executive team meetings, and company-wide meetings

  • Identify ways to improve how the Office of the CEOs operates and build processes that scale

What you bring

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, senior Executive Assistant, or Business Partner to a C-level executive, ideally in a high-growth startup

  • Experience supporting a CEO through board cycles and company-wide communications

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, or another regulated industry

  • A proven record of managing complex, high-stakes calendars and logistics with exceptional precision and no missed details

  • Exceptional judgment and discretion in handling confidential matters and acting on the Co-CEO’s behalf

  • Excellent communication skills and the executive presence to work comfortably with C-suite leaders, board members, and external partners

  • Experience managing or mentoring executive assistants or other administrative professionals

  • Ability to travel at a moment’s notice

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We are currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Consumer team. The Consumer team at Kraken focuses on building applications that expose Kraken's product offering to the mass market. Trying to onboard the next 100 million people to the benefits of crypto.

 

This role involves setting the technical direction for our "Consumer" applications — a suite of products aimed at offering the simplest way for our customers to interact with Kraken — and delivering the hardest parts of it yourself. We expect anyone applying for this role to have an extreme eye for detail, a passion for building genuinely world class user experiences, a "ship fast but don't ship shit" attitude, and the judgment to know which is which without being told.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the architecture and delivery of customer-facing Rust backend services powering trading, payments, and crypto experiences — making the design calls on systems that will outlive the feature you built them for

  • Take ambiguous, multi-quarter problems from "we think this matters" to shipped and measured, breaking them down so the rest of the team can move in parallel with you

  • Own features end-to-end rather than stopping at the API/backend boundary, and raise the bar on what "end-to-end" means for everyone around you — customer experience, frontend impact, and the product problem behind what you're building

  • Partner with product leadership to shape the roadmap for a product area, not just execute against it. You'll bring engineering insight that changes what gets built, and own the outcomes and metrics that follow

  • Drive initiatives that cross team boundaries — Kraken's trading infrastructure, platform, and other product teams — building the relationships and technical alignment needed to land them

  • Multiply the team: mentor mid-level engineers, review designs before code exists, unblock people quickly, and leave behind patterns and standards that make the next feature easier than the last

  • Use AI extensively to amplify scope and speed, moving from manually writing code toward orchestrating AI and validating implementation — and help the team do the same, defining what good AI-assisted engineering looks like here

 

What you bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep Rust proficiency across network services, asynchronous code, and distributed systems design (RPC protocols, Kafka, event-driven architectures)

  • A track record of owning systems, not just features. You've made architectural decisions in production, lived with the consequences, and can explain the tradeoffs you'd make differently now

  • Product engineering mindset. You've shipped features from problem → implementation → launch → user impact, with deep understanding of customer experience and product metrics, and you've influenced what got built and what got cut

  • Demonstrated impact through others: mentoring, design review, technical writing, or setting standards that changed how a team worked

  • Experience driving work that spans teams or orgs, where the hard part was alignment and sequencing as much as the code

  • AI-first development approach where AI is already meaningfully incorporated into your workflow; you actively use AI for coding, understanding unfamiliar codebases, crossing technical boundaries, and validating implementations

  • Ownership mindset with collaborative spirit. You personally drive features end-to-end, work across backend/frontend boundaries, and operate outside technical silos

  • Openness to how the engineering profession is evolving because of AI, prioritizing shipping valuable products over manual code writing

 

Nice to haves

  • Full-stack experience including React/TypeScript or other frontend frameworks — valuable for demonstrating cross-boundary collaboration mindset

  • Cryptocurrency or blockchain domain knowledge

  • Experience building and scaling products at consumer-focused technology companies, ideally at meaningful user scale

  • Experience introducing AI tooling or workflows to an engineering team

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team



Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard.

Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market:

  • Managing uncertainty: Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record

  • Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly

  • Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap.

  • Builder mentality: We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge

  • Team work: Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition

In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below.

The opportunity

  • Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies

  • Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends

  • Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods

  • Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement

  • Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.)

  • Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market

  • Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring

What you bring

  • Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org

  • High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing

  • High motor

  • Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities

  • Strong product sense

  • Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics

  • High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise.

  • Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting

  • Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and work agile around the globe.

 

The Opportunity

  • Design and implement robust Rust services and libraries that power trading, payments, and crypto experiences with a focus on reliability, performance, and user impact.

  • Write reusable, testable, and highly efficient code that scales across teams and supports revenue-critical systems without compromising safety or security.

  • Collaborate on large-scale distributed systems architecture, translating evolving product requirements into resilient, low-latency solutions.

  • Work alongside hundreds of experienced Rust engineers, contributing to a high-performance, product-driven engineering culture.

 

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience building financial trading focused products

  • Proficient in writing network services or asynchronous code in Rust

  • Have a security-first mindset during system design to ensure robustness

  • Demonstrate the ability to autonomously debug issues across the stack (OS, network, application)

  • Apply a solid understanding of distributed systems and technologies, including RPC protocols, Kafka, and Event-Driven Systems, to design scalable solutions

  • Collaborate effectively with product teams to gather requirements and constraints for designing appropriate systems

The team

 

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are currently seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our growing Consumer team. The Consumer team at Kraken focuses on building applications that expose Kraken’s product offering to the mass market. Trying to onboard the next 100 million people to the benefits of crypto.


This role primarily involves developing features and maintaining our “Consumer” applications, which consists of a suite of applications aimed at offering the simplest way for our customers to interact with Kraken. We expect anyone applying for this role to have an extreme eye for detail, a passion for building genuinely world class user experiences, a “ship fast but don’t ship shit” attitude and be highly self driven.

 

The opportunity

  • Design and implement customer-facing Rust backend services powering trading, payments, and crypto experiences

  • Own features end-to-end rather than stopping at the API/backend boundary, understanding customer experience, frontend impact, and the product problem behind what you're building.

  • Collaborate with product teams to understand customer requirements and integrate with Kraken's trading infrastructure while maintaining a product-led engineering focus

  • Propose improvements and drive solutions autonomously. You're not simply implementing specifications, but translating evolving product requirements into resilient solutions that ship valuable experiences.

  • Use AI extensively to amplify scope and speed, moving from manually writing code toward orchestrating AI and validating implementation, increasingly focused on problem definition, architecture, and product validation.

 

What you bring

  • Rust/backend engineer with proficiency in network services, asynchronous code, and distributed systems design (RPC protocols, Kafka, event-driven architectures)

  • Product engineering mindset. You've shipped features from problem → implementation → launch → user impact, with deep understanding of customer experience and product metrics

  • AI-first development approach where AI is already meaningfully incorporated into your workflow; you actively use AI for coding, understanding unfamiliar codebases, crossing technical boundaries, and validating implementations

  • Ownership mindset with collaborative spirit. You personally drive features end-to-end, work across backend/frontend boundaries and operate outside technical silos

  • Security-first approach to system design with ability to autonomously debug across the stack (OS, network, application)

  • Openness to how the engineering profession is evolving because of AI, prioritizing shipping valuable products over manual code writing

Nice to haves

  • Full-stack experience including React/TypeScript or other frontend frameworks - valuable for demonstrating cross-boundary collaboration mindset

  • Cryptocurrency or blockchain domain knowledge

  • Experience building products at consumer-focused technology companies

The Voice team is Client Engagement’s premium support channel for high-value clients, providing voice support through the Kraken apps. Join a fast-paced frontline team and shape Kraken client journeys. This is a tremendous growth path for an ambitious specialist with a strong performance record and growth mindset. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to round out generalist customer service skills, elevate communication, and work up close with clients. You’ll assist clients and help grow the next generation of Kraken clients across multiple geographies through new products and services, an exciting, hands-on adventure with meaningful impact.

This role offers a fixed-term contract, for the duration of 6 months.

 

The opportunity

  • Answer inbound Voice calls with friendly, professional service, drive quick, accurate resolutions

  • Clarify client goals, provide education on Kraken products and services, and guide funding, trading, and other account activities

  • Test new products and features to develop expertise that resolves issues end-to-end and responsibly position products where they fit

  • Build client relationships, identify growth opportunities and connect clients with Kraken products that meet their needs.

  • Achieve goals with your manager, contribute to team discussions and 1:1s, and help improve the client experience through feedback and growth projects.

 

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service or business support role where you’ve proven to be a pro at delivering a 5-star experience. This can be within retail, hospitality, or a customer service center

  • You must be willing to work shifts on a 24/7 rotating schedule, including evenings and weekends

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with strong workflow accuracy and process adherence

  • Highly organized, with excellent time management across multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Fluency in both English and Spanish at native-like level; proficiency in Portuguese is a plus

  • Quick to grasp new concepts, systems, and process changes, and skilled at explaining complex procedures clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

  • A foundational understanding of how crypto trading works, with the eagerness to deepen that knowledge as Kraken’s product suite grows.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.

You’re going to fix that.

The opportunity

We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.

We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.

  • Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.

  • Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.

  • Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.

  • Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.

  • Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

  • Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

  • Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

  • Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.

  • Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.

  • Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.

  • UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.

  • High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.

  • Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.

  • Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.

  • Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.

  • Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.

  • Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.

  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of technical growth, collaboration, and inclusivity.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

  • Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

  • Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

  • Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

  • Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

  • Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

  • Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

  • Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

  • Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

  • Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

  • Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

  • Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

  • Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

  • Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

  • Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

  • Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps

  • Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

 - Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

 - Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

 - Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

 - Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

 - Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

 - Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

 - Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

 - Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

  • Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

  • Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

  • Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

  • Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

  • Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

  • Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

  • Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

  • Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 

What you bring

  • Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

  • Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

  • Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

  • Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

  • Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

  • Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

  • Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 

Nice to haves

  • Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

  • Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

  • Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. Manager, Model Risk Management to join our team, focusing on Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessments models for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) purposes.     • Assessing model performance, accuracy, and stability.

    • Evaluating model risk and identifying potential biases.

    • Reviewing AI Models for AML/CFT Program

  • AML/CFT Regulatory Compliance: ensure that Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessment models comply with relevant AML/CFT regulations, including but not limited to:

    • EU AML/CFT Directives.

    • US BSA/AML regulations.

    • FATF recommendations.

  • Risk Assessment: conduct risk assessments to identify potential AML/CFT risks associated with Transaction Monitoring and Customer Risk Assessment models, including but not limited to:

    • Identifying higher-risk customer segments, products, and geographies.

    • Assessing the effectiveness of controls and mitigants.

  • Model Monitoring and Maintenance: develop and implement procedures for ongoing model monitoring and maintenance, including but not limited to:

    • Annual reporting & certification

    • Tracking model performance and identifying degradation.

    • Conducting regular model reviews and updates.

  • Collaboration and Communication: collaborate with various stakeholders, including but not limited to:

    • Model Engineering and owners.

    • AML/CFT subject matter experts.

    • Business units and risk management teams.

  • Documentation and Reporting: prepare and maintain high-quality documentation, including but not limited to:

    • Model validation reports.

    • Risk assessments.

    • Regulatory compliance reports.

  • Methodology Development: contribute to the development and maintenance of model validation methodologies, including but not limited to:

    • Developing and refining model validation frameworks.

    • Identifying best practices and industry standards.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques.

  • Deep understanding of fiat and crypto payment flows

  • Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL).

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

  • Strong understanding of financial markets, products, and services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Principal Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

 

The opportunity

  • Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

  • Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

  • Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

  • Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

 
 

What you bring

  • Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

  • Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

 
 

Nice to haves

  • E-comms surveillance experience.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.



Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.



We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.



 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

 - Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

 - Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

 - Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

 - Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

 - Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

 - A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

 - Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

 - Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

 - Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

 - Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

 - Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

 - Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

 
 


NICE TO HAVES

 - E-comms surveillance experience.

 
 



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
