jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Join our growing Product Legal team of 10, embedded with Kraken’s Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We’re a tight, experienced group of product lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice - partnering directly with product teams to chart clear, defensible paths to launch.

This is a fully remote role for a qualified solicitor in the UK or admitted in an EU jurisdiction.

 

The opportunity

The Senior Counsel (Consumer Legal) role is based in the UK or EU within our Consumer Legal team, partnering on cutting edge consumer products including crypto trading, earn, payments, on-chain integrations, equities, and tokenised equities. Reporting to the Head of Consumer Legal, you’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to shape and ship novel consumer products and experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong product development instincts, regulatory fluency, and negotiation skills (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector) combined with a crypto-forward mindset. Curiosity, flexibility, and a bias for action at the intersection of crypto and traditional global markets are essential.

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State).

  • 5+ years’ PQE in financial services law gained at a regulated financial services firm, crypto services provider, or in private practice (ideally with direct product counselling experience).

  • Preference for experience with advising on regulated MiFID investment services and familiarity with relevant crypto-asset regimes, including MiCA, AMLD5, UK financial promotions, and/or e-money regulations.

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing.

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyers and product stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and delivers clear recommendations to decision-makers.

  • Demonstrates an authentic passion for crypto and familiarity with the features of both Kraken and its competitors’ apps and products.

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Expertise in MiCA framework applicable to CASPs including brokerage, custody and the operation of trading platforms.

  • Expertise in UK crypto-asset financial promotions regime and proposals for incoming authorisation regime for regulating crypto asset service providers.

  • Expertise in MiFID frameworks applicable to investment services including derivatives, equities, funds and emerging tokenised financial instruments.

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase efficient provision of legal services, create custom GPTs allowing stakeholders to self-serve on commoditised legal and regulatory queries.

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

The Director, Legal Operations will serve as the centralized owner for Legal’s operations, technology, data, and execution. This role is responsible for Legal AI strategy and implementation, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, and other stakeholders to modernize and scale Kraken’s legal function. As Kraken’s regulatory footprint and business complexity grow, this leader will own operational strategy, tooling, process design, and metrics—driving automation, AI adoption, workflow standardization, and vendor optimization. This role ensures Legal operates as a strategic, data-driven partner to the business rather than a reactive cost center.

This leader will also be responsible for Legal’s financial, resourcing, and demand management foundations—ensuring the right work is done by the right resource at the right cost, with predictable outcomes as the organization scales.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Serve as DRI for Legal Operations, Legal Technology, and Legal AI strategy, execution, and governance.

  • Own Legal’s operating model across workflows, processes, resourcing, and service delivery.

  • Own budget planning, forecasting, accruals, and cost modeling with Finance.

  • Manage legal billing and outside counsel.

  • Lead resourcing, capacity planning, headcount modeling, role design, and make/buy/automate decisions.

  • Manage the legal technology stack (CLM, matter management, AI tools, knowledge management, intake, spend management).

  • Enforce centralized ownership, standardization, and compliance across legal technology.

  • Evaluate AI tooling, drive build-vs-buy decisions, translate requirements into technical roadmaps, ensure secure deployment, measure ROI, and lead integrations.

  • Establish metrics, dashboards, and controls for workload, demand, spend, cycle times, efficiency, risk, and outcomes.

  • Design and operate intake, triage, and demand-management frameworks, including prioritization models, service tiers, SLAs, and self-service pathways.

  • Optimize vendor and contractor management, spend controls, billing review, performance measurement, and work allocation.

  • Design, implement, and adopt AI-enabled legal workflows at scale.

  • Evolve the Legal knowledge management strategy (playbooks, templates, decision trees, guidance) for reuse and automation.

  • Prioritize operational, process, and technology initiatives based on impact, risk reduction, and ROI.

  • Lead change management, training, and adoption for new processes, technologies, and AI systems.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, privacy, and compliance standards.

  • Maintain operational controls to reduce legal, regulatory, and model risk.

  • Enable attorneys to focus on legal judgment, strategy, and advisory work.

 
 

What you bring

  • 10+ years in Legal Operations, legal technology, process design, finance-adjacent operations, or operational leadership.

  • Experience scaling legal operations, legal technology, financial management, and data-driven execution.

  • Experience driving automation and AI initiatives from strategy through deployment, governance, adoption, and ROI measurement.

  • Understanding of legal workflows (contracts, regulatory, litigation, investigations, intake, outside counsel management) and process redesign.

  • Hands-on experience optimizing legal technology platforms (CLM, matter management, spend management, intake, knowledge management, AI tools).

  • Ability to translate requirements into technical roadmaps and operational plans.

  • Experience establishing metrics, dashboards, controls, and OKRs.

  • Communication skills to influence legal leaders, executives, and technical teams.

  • Experience operating in ambiguity and leading transformation in high-growth environments.

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or regulated industries.

  • Background in enterprise AI governance, model risk management, or secure AI deployment.

  • People management experience in Legal Operations or adjacent functions.

  • Experience benchmarking Legal Operations practices, tooling, and cost structures against industry standards.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - xStocks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

xStocks brings real-world assets on-chain as tokenized securities that are regulated, fully-backed, and tradable across multiple blockchains. Built within Payward, the xStocks team runs the infrastructure that issues, custodies, and settles these instruments across EVM, Solana, TON, Tron, and more. The platform moves real value, so security is not a feature bolted on at the end. It is a property of everything the team ships. This is a hybrid engineering and security seat built for someone who is genuinely both: you ship products alongside the engineering team when the security queue is quiet, and you own security work end to end when it lands. You report into engineering and partner closely with the Payward security, CISO, and compliance functions.

The opportunity

  • Own security deliverables end to end. Coordinate and review smart-contract audits, respond to security questionnaires and due-diligence requests, support CISO and compliance initiatives, and turn findings into tracked, closed-out fixes.

  • Run offensive assessments against our own platforms. Pentest the web apps, APIs, backend services, and on-chain components, and build the tooling to do it repeatedly rather than once.

  • Continuously assess posture. Threat-model new and existing systems, review architecture and key-management flows, and maintain a living view of the risks and their mitigations.

  • Review code for security. Be a default reviewer on changes touching auth, cryptography, custody, signing, and fund movement across our chains.

  • Harden the platform. Improve secrets handling, IAM and least-privilege, dependency and supply-chain hygiene, and detection and logging for security-relevant events.

  • Secure custody and signing workflows. Review and harden transaction signing flows, MPC and HSM integrations, signer permissions, admin roles, approval policies, and break-glass procedures.

  • Contribute to product engineering. Pick up regular backlog work in TypeScript so you stay close to the codebase you are defending.

  • Support incidents. Help with detection, triage, response, and post-mortems, and feed the lessons back into the program.

What you bring

  • An engineer first. You write and review production code comfortably, TypeScript and Node.js in our stack, and you understand systems deeply enough to break them.

  • Strong application and infrastructure security fundamentals. The OWASP-class vulnerability landscape, authn and authz, injection, SSRF, supply-chain risk, and secure design. You have done real offensive work in pentesting, vuln research, or red-team.

  • Applied cryptography and blockchain security. Symmetric and asymmetric primitives, hashing, signatures, and key management, plus the security model of EVM, Solana, and ideally TON or Tron. You can read a smart contract and reason about how it fails.

  • Ownership. You can take an ambiguous security item, an audit, a questionnaire, or an incident, and drive it to closure without being managed through it.

  • Clear communication. You can explain a risk to engineers, to a CISO, and to an auditor, and tailor the message to each.

  • An automation instinct. You do not want to catch the same issue manually twice, so you turn findings into tests, alerts, controls, documentation, or platform improvements.

  • Risk judgment. You can tell a theoretical issue from a material one, and communicate severity, likelihood, impact, and remediation tradeoffs clearly.

Nice to have

  • Experience commissioning or remediating third-party smart-contract audits.

  • Familiarity with custody and signing infrastructure such as HSMs, MPC, and ForDefi-style providers, and with on-chain transaction security.

  • Cloud security depth in GCP or AWS, IAM, and container and runtime hardening.

  • Detection engineering and security observability, including SIEM and log-based detections.

  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or GWAPT.

  • Prior work in a regulated fintech or tokenization/DeFi environment.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and C++ and work agile around the globe.

  • Design and implement robust Rust and C++ services and libraries that power trading, payments, and crypto experiences with a focus on reliability, performance, and user impact.

  • Collaborate on large-scale distributed systems architecture, translating evolving product requirements into resilient, low-latency solutions.

  • Work alongside hundreds of experienced Rust and C++ engineers, contributing to a high-performance, product-driven engineering culture.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience building financial trading focused products

  • Proficient in writing network services or asynchronous code in Rust

  • Experience with modern C++, including performance-sensitive, low-latency systems

  • Have a security-first mindset during system design to ensure robustness

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Corporate Legal team is a trusted advisor at the heart of Kraken’s operations, guiding the company through complex legal landscapes while enabling innovation and growth. Within this team, the Equity Administration function plays a critical role in managing Kraken’s cap table, equity programs, and global stock plan compliance. The team partners closely with Legal, Accounting, Finance, HR, and Executive Leadership to ensure that equity is administered accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with the company’s strategic goals.

As Manager of Equity Administration, you’ll lead the design and execution of Kraken’s global equity programs, oversee cap table management, and be the primary point of contact for all equity-related matters. You will work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, People, and external stakeholders to support strategic transactions, maintain compliance, and ensure a seamless equity experience for Krakenites around the world. This position reports to the Director of Equity.

The opportunity

  • Accurately and timely conduct the day-to-day administration of the company’s equity plans globally

  • Maintain company capitalization table including regular inputting of new grants, share issuances, and complex vesting schedules

  • Manage all participant equity plan transactions (grants, exercises, etc.) and ensure that they are correctly processed in a timely manner

  • Communicate with equity plan participants regarding the equity programs, resolving questions, issues, and concerns related to vesting, transactions, enrollment, and other general inquiries

  • Manage option exercises, pending new hires, and other grant lists and reconcile transactions, termination dates, tax withholding, and reporting, and other items as required

  • Provide day to day support to the Corporate Governance, HR, Payroll and Finance teams with respect to equity compensation reporting and data

  • Work with internal and external auditors and finance team for quarterly reviews, year-end audits and regulatory audits of procedures and controls as needed

  • Manage secondary market transactions including management of highly detail intensive step-by-step closing process

  • Provide assistance to the Corporate Governance team in facilitating and preparing documents related to stock transfers

  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

What you bring

  • B.A. or similar degree

  • 6+ years of related experience as stock plan administrator in startup or corporate practice

  • International public company company experience

  • Significant experience with eShareworks

  • Strong technical skills especially MS Excel or other spreadsheet programs

  • Commitment to process, tracking and reporting, and responsiveness

  • Hands-on proficiency using generative AI tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) in day-to-day work, with sound judgment on verifying outputs and protecting confidentiality, privilege, and personal data

Nice to haves

  • Certified Equity Professionals (CEP) designation preferred

  • Paralegal / Fintech / Startup experience

  • Both pre-IPO and post-IPO experience (or similar public offering)

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As Director, US Operations, you will lead operations for Payward’s US equities business: our registered broker-dealer, Kraken Securities LLC, and the operations behind traditional stocks as well as xStocks, our tokenized equities product. You will own the trade operating model, the end-to-end order and settlement flow, cash flows, corporate actions, reconciliations, and regulatory readiness across the business.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a regulated entity. You will be a registered principal of Kraken Securities LLC, named on Form BD, and accountable for the operational side of the firm’s regulatory obligations. It extends well beyond day-to-day management and requires genuine fluency in both traditional market plumbing and the operational realities of a digital-asset business.

You will stay close to company strategy and cross-functional initiatives so the global executive team’s goals translate into clear operating priorities. As a trusted partner, you will work across Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to drive key initiatives forward, and build the team that scales the business as the firm grows.

The opportunity

  • Own the end-to-end order flow for US equities, from inception through clearing and settlement, including reconciliation, corporate actions, and exception management

  • Own xStocks operations: token issuance and redemption, inventory and liquidity management, movement of client and firm assets, and settlement across exchange, custodian, and on-chain venues

  • Serve as a named principal of Kraken Securities LLC and act as an operational control point — including dual-approval (“four eyes”) sign-off on transactions and asset movements, with coverage across time zones

  • Design and implement the operating model for Kraken Securities and xStocks, aligned to strategic goals

  • Build and run the operating systems for the business — policies, written supervisory procedures, controls, books and records, business continuity, and KPIs — and translate C-suite goals into clear targets for each business unit

  • Own launch readiness for new products and markets: prepare systems, policies and procedures, and test them end to end with our clearing firm, custodians, exchange partners and R&D teams to ensure compliance with US regulations

  • Partner with Finance on financial controls around bank payments, customer funds and reserve requirements

  • Ensure desk coverage and settlement/ reconciliation controls and man power in place to support 24X5 and transitioning to 24x7

  • Own vendor and partner operations — clearing, custody, market data, liquidity providers and technology vendors — including onboarding, SLAs and ongoing oversight

  • Own severity-1 operational escalation and incident response for the US entities, including root-cause review and remediation

  • Set performance targets, monitor progress, and report KPIs and costs transparently to leadership

  • Hire and develop a high-performing operations team, build the licensing bench and succession plan, and build the organizational structure to scale

  • Partner with functional leaders across Marketing, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to keep initiatives aligned and moving

  • Contribute to strategy and growth planning to help build a sustainable business

  • Support functions such as HR and IT in building procedures that link to corporate strategy

What you bring

  • 12+ years of experience in brokerage or fintech operations, and/or at an operations consulting firm, including time inside a FINRA-registered broker-dealer

  • Experience in crypto, brokerage, advisory, fintech, or another highly regulated industry

  • In-depth knowledge of traditional financial markets — execution, clearing, settlement, custody, margin, securities lending, and corporate actions

  • Working understanding of digital assets and tokenized securities, including custody models, on-chain settlement, and the operational controls they demand

  • Direct experience operating under SEC and FINRA rules — books and records, supervisory procedures, trade reporting, and examination response

  • Experience standing up or scaling operations for a new regulated product or entity, including launch readiness and regulatory approval processes

  • A proven record of defining structured approaches to solve complex challenges

  • End-to-end understanding of company value drivers and a strong working understanding of business analytics

  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing operations teams

  • Exceptional judgment and the executive presence to work comfortably with C-suite leaders, regulators, and external partners

  • Required at hire, or within an agreed window from start date: FINRA Series 7 (General Securities Representative), Series 99 (Operations Professional) and Series 24 (General Securities Principal)

  • Preferred: Series 27 or 28 (Financial and Operations Principal)

  • Also valued: Series 57 (Securities Trader) and Series 4 (options principal), or willingness to obtain them — these strengthen our principal coverage across trading and options

  • Must be eligible for registration and disclosure on Form BD, and comfortable carrying named-principal responsibility in a regulated entity

  • Series 63 / 65 / 66 as required by state registration

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Manager, Policy & Government Relations, APAC. APAC is a strategic growth region for us. You will be working on shaping the financial services and web3/digital policy and regulatory landscape across some of the world's most dynamic and fast-evolving markets. Your initial focus will be Singapore and other key Asian markets.

 

The opportunity

  • Become a key player in our truly global policy team based across Brussels, London, Washington DC, and now Singapore

  • Lead the development of Kraken's policy positions across APAC, and in doing so contribute to the comprehensive company-wide strategy

  • Engage directly with key policymakers and regulators, starting with Singapore (MAS and other government bodies), the Philippines, Vietnam, South Korea and others

  • Gain external visibility working with trade associations and other external players

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise internally on legislative and regulatory developments across the region, keeping a global view

  • Partner closely with colleagues in the regulatory, compliance, communications, product, and engineering teams

  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

 

What you bring

  • 5–9 years of hands-on experience with financial services policy and regulation in APAC, gained at regulators or government bodies (e.g. MAS or peer authorities in the region), in similar in-house roles, political consultancies, or relevant trade associations

  • Existing network in Singapore and, ideally, across the wider region

  • Understanding of or an interest in financial services and digital policy, including the emerging regional frameworks for digital assets, payments, and stablecoins

  • Team-oriented mindset, proactive and entrepreneurial approach, the ability to embrace a steep learning curve, and to face headwinds

  • Comfort operating across diverse regulatory cultures and political systems, and willingness to travel within the region

  • Passion for the industry and an interest in Kraken's offerings and its global impact

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Knowledge of payments, AML, cyber, or other financial services and digital policy frameworks in the region

  • Experience with drafting responses to public consultations

  • Exposure to Central Asian, Australian, or Middle Eastern regulatory environments

  • Interest in international politics and the ability to explain it to a diversified audience

  • Prior exposure to the work of international standard setters (IOSCO, OECD, FATF) and an understanding of how their work relates to national and regional policies

  • Regional language skills are a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships.

We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you.

 

The opportunity

  • Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships.

  • Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients.

  • Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time.

  • Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks.

  • Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries.

  • Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust.

  • Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams.

  • Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients.

  • Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs.

  • An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile.

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus.

  • Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early.

  • Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue.

  • Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results.

  • Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region.

  • Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences.

  • Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team.

 

Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products.

 

The opportunity

  • Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects.

  • Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets.

  • Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live.

  • Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering.

  • Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is.

  • Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning.

 

What you bring

  • 3+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential.

  • Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit.

  • Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust.

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows.

  • Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show.

  • End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities.

 

Nice to haves

  • Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto.

  • Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts.

  • Rust experience, given our backend stack.

  • SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data.

  • AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach.

  • Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Sr. Executive Assistant to support senior leadership within the CEO office, including operating within a Co-CEO leadership model. This role provides high-level administrative support and ensures key projects, budgets, travel, and events run seamlessly — managing complex, ever-changing calendars with responsibility for multifaceted coordination. The ideal candidate brings experience or familiarity with communications and executive affairs, enabling them to operate confidently in a fast-paced environment.

The Opportunity

  • Work in lockstep with other EAs within the CEO office, understanding the unique dynamics of a Co-CEO leadership model — sharing information, coordinating responsibilities, and maintaining seamless executive support across leaders.

  • Build relationships with the broader team while acting as a gatekeeper for the executives; anticipate needs and potential issues before they arise, planning for multiple contingencies and implementing solutions with minimal direction.

  • Manage an exceptionally complex and ever-changing executive calendar, balancing competing priorities and making thoughtful decisions on behalf of the CEO; coordinate meetings, handle logistics, manage competing deadlines, and review incoming requests to ensure they're on the Executive's radar with all necessary information.

  • Prepare comprehensive briefing materials for meetings, speaking events, and travel, along with agendas, minutes, and organized records of key projects and initiatives.

  • Coordinate all aspects of domestic and international travel — commercial and private aircraft, ground transportation, accommodations, visas, and customs requirements — and serve as the primary point of contact for private aviation providers, managing flight schedules, passenger manifests, and catering.

  • Monitor travel plans proactively, adjusting logistics in real time to accommodate changing business priorities, weather events, operational delays, or other unforeseen circumstances.

  • Coordinate cross-functional projects and events — including timelines, deliverables, stakeholder engagement, and partnering with events, security, and other teams — while identifying opportunities to streamline processes and enhance executive effectiveness.

  • Track and oversee team tasks, budgets, and meeting schedules to ensure deadlines and deliverables are met, and support onboarding and ramp-up for new team members.

  • Process expense reports, purchase orders, budget reconciliations, and receipts/invoices with accuracy and timeliness, along with additional duties as assigned.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of proven experience as an executive assistant, administrative manager, or similar role supporting senior leadership, ideally within a CEO office or multi-executive leadership structure.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercising discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting with strong personalities and demanding timeframes.

  • Natural talent for improving processes and bringing order out of chaos, remaining calm during periods of disorganization.

  • Strong sense of urgency when projects are assigned, with the ability to complete tasks quickly while anticipating the next one in short succession.

  • Highly proficient with Google Suite, MS Office Suite, Adobe Suite, MacOS, and generally tech savvy.

  • Familiarity with communications strategies, executive affairs, and leadership environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Flexibility in approach — this business operates across all time zones.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in budget tracking, travel coordination, event planning, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Comfort working across multiple teams, time zones, and with external partners.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a focus on efficiency.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic

  • Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication

  • Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows

  • Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes

  • Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time

  • Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results

  • Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems

  • Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards.

 

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD

  • Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

  • A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics

  • Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English

 

Nice to haves

  • Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications

  • Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack

  • Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning

  • Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring

  • Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection

  • Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments

jobs.title: Head of Financial Systems Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken is on a mission to build the most trusted bridge between crypto and traditional finance. The Financial Systems Engineering team connects activity across products, payments, banking, and digital assets to the data, ledgers, controls, and applications Finance relies on. Our engineers bring expertise in data engineering, complex transaction flows, financial systems, and reconciliation. We partner with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Product, Risk, Security, Compliance, and platform engineering to make financial data reliable, explainable, and auditable.

The opportunity

  • Report to the CFO and lead the engineering vision for Kraken’s financial systems, translating Finance priorities into a clear technical strategy and delivery roadmap

  • Assess the current landscape, including fragmented data, processes, and technical debt. Define a target architecture and phased transformation plan based on evidence, business needs, and sound engineering judgment

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of specialists across financial systems, data engineering, integrations, and ledger-related services. Establish clear ownership and develop technical leaders

  • Set standards for the completeness, quality, lineage, and ownership of financial data, from source events through transaction and balance records, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting

  • Contribute to architecture decisions for ledgers, subledgers, financial data models, APIs, and integrations across fiat and crypto activity. Determine what should be standardized and where distinct product flows need governed treatment

  • Partner with Accounting and Treasury to improve account and legal entity attribution, financial controls, reconciliation, exception handling, and the traceability of records across internal and external systems

  • Lead modernization and migration without disrupting close, reporting, fund movements, or other critical Finance operations. Define validation checkpoints and criteria for retiring legacy processes and systems

  • Establish end-to-end testing, documentation, observability, release controls, and incident response practices that account for the financial impact of upstream changes

  • Partner with Product, platform engineering, Risk, Security, Compliance, Tax, and Legal on system boundaries, access controls, resilience, regulatory needs, and auditability

  • Evaluate build, buy, and integration options; review consequential designs; and communicate architectural decisions, sequencing, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to Finance and Engineering leaders

What you will tackle first

In your first year, you’ll build the foundations for a more reliable, scalable Finance architecture:

  • Move key reconciliations from a monthly to a daily cadence, with clear ownership and a process for resolving exceptions

  • Reduce the time needed to find the root cause of reconciliation breaks from weeks to days

  • Map and validate the source tables and transformations that actually feed financial statements, establishing lineage and ownership

  • Complete the UAT data lake connections needed to test financial data flows end to end before changes reach production

What you bring

  • Significant software engineering and technical leadership experience, including leading experienced teams through complex financial systems or data architecture change

  • A strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing specialists while creating clear ownership, high engineering standards, and effective cross-functional partnerships

  • Deep understanding of ledgers, subledgers, double-entry concepts, reconciliation, settlement, and the path from an operational event to an auditable financial record

  • Experience with crypto or digital asset infrastructure and the challenges of connecting on-chain activity, internal balances, custody or wallet flows, and traditional financial systems

  • Strong technical judgment in distributed systems, data engineering, APIs, event-driven processing, and integrations across complex platforms

  • Experience defining a target architecture and delivering a transformation roadmap across fragmented or legacy systems while sustaining production reliability

  • Experience designing for data completeness, accuracy, lineage, reconciliation, access control, and auditability

  • Sound judgment in production operations, including incident response, monitoring, debugging, change management, and reliability improvements

  • Ability to partner with senior Finance and Engineering leaders and translate financial, operational, and control needs into a practical engineering roadmap

  • Ability to lead experts and make informed architecture decisions without needing to be the deepest specialist in every domain; clear communication of priorities and tradeoffs to executives and technical teams

  • Experience with Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, or Python; finance applications such as NetSuite, Kyriba, or BlackLine; and SOX or SOC control environments is valuable

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Lead transaction monitoring optimization, including rule testing, threshold tuning, and the design and rollout of new monitoring scenarios to improve detection quality and reduce false positives

  • Identify and drive automation and workflow improvements across FIU processes to increase operational efficiency and effectiveness

  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including LLM and AI-enabled tools, to enhance alert triage, investigations, SAR filing and FIU operational capabilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to support vendor integrations, monitoring infrastructure improvements, and FIU tooling enhancements

  • Collaborate with Compliance leadership, including RCOs and MLROs, to maintain well-governed transaction monitoring frameworks aligned with regulatory expectations

  • Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

  • 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

  • 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

  • Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

  • Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, or Operations teams to implement monitoring controls, vendor integrations, or compliance technology solutions

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with experience using metrics, dashboards, and data analysis to evaluate monitoring effectiveness and improve detection quality

  • Experience operating in fast-growing fintech, payments, or crypto environments, with the ability to design scalable compliance controls that support new product launches and geographic expansion

  • Experience working with AI, machine learning, or LLM-enabled compliance tools, including investigative automation or alert triage technologies

  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar crypto investigative platforms

  • Experience supporting vendor selection, implementation, or integration of regtech solutions

 
 

Nice to haves

  • ACAMS, CAMS-Audit, CFCS, or similar financial crime certifications

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We are looking for a Data Centre Operations Engineer to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Centre Operations is a ‘hands-on’ role that is critical to the continuing success of Kraken; you will join a highly motivated team that is responsible for managing the entire network and compute infrastructure for one of the world’s leading Cryptocurrency exchanges. We are looking for a dynamic and innovative self-starter with the ability to think “outside of the box” to solve complex problems in a sustainable way.

This role requires onsite work in New York/New Jersey area.

 

The opportunity

  • Performs expert preventive and corrective on-site maintenance on critical exchange infrastructure

  • Installs and configures complex server and networking systems

  • Provides comprehensive on-site facility support, including installation, decommissioning, and break/fix work

  • Manages contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure compliance with site procedures

  • Responsible for maintaining site-level asset accuracy, documentation, and ITAM, NetBox (IPAM, DCIM) updates. Ensuring all documentation and rack layouts remain accurate, audit-ready, and traceable

  • Supports financial and capacity planning through cost projections and renewal tracking

  • Leads or assists in capacity planning to maintain adequate spare capacity and plan timely backfills

  • Assume on-call responsibilities and duties per the schedule & travel as needed to support physical data centre and office locations

  • Monitors, maintains, and troubleshoots physical infrastructure, including on-call and travel duties as required

 

What you bring

  • 3 + years experience of data centre operations in a highly security focused environment

  • 3 + years experience working in a large-scale data centre environment

  • Experience with power, cooling and airflow management of physical devices.

  • Basic knowledge of IP addressing and subnets/gateway configuration.

  • Demonstrated accountability for site or system ownership in a large-scale environment.

  • Physical network work: precise cabling and patching to a port map, choosing the right optics and cables, and ordering and removing cross-connects with colocation providers.

  • Change and access control: raising change tickets and working within maintenance windows. Site-access tickets, escorting visitors, and badge and door-controller faults.

  • Logistics: inbound shipment tickets, loading-bay handoffs, and shipping kit between sites.

  • New-site build-out: planning and executing new site installs, including rack layouts, patching and power plans, quote checks, and incident reports. This is project work as well as operations.

  • Multi-region work: collaboration across the US, EU, UK and APAC.

  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to maintain a single source of truth for assets, capacity, and dependencies.

  • Understanding of financial planning or forecasting in an operational context.

  • Ability to collaborate across teams and regions with transparency and professionalism.

  • Ability to perform under pressure with high attention to detail.

  • Physical labour skill, able to lift more than 25 kgs

jobs.title: Sr. Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring several Senior Compliance Associates to carry out day to day surveillance across our markets, investigate what that surveillance uncovers, and help us build the programme out as the business grows.

 

The opportunity

  • Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

  • Carry out analytical reviews that begin with trade and order data rather than with a system-generated alert.

  • Investigate escalated behaviour end to end: gather the data, reconstruct what happened, and write it up for presentation to senior compliance stakeholders.

  • Assess referrals raised from across the business and externally, and take forward the ones that warrant it.

  • Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

  • Produce management information and regulatory reporting for the entities we cover.

  • Contribute to surveillance platform and tooling work, including bringing new products and data sources into scope and testing that detection behaves as intended.

  • Use AI and automation tools to speed up evidence-gathering and case reconstruction, with human judgement over the final call.

 

What you bring

  • At least 2 years experience in trade surveillance, market abuse investigation or trading conduct inside a regulated firm, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, bank or comparable regulated trading business.

  • Working knowledge of the core market abuse typologies, for example spoofing, layering, wash trading, insider dealing, front running and ramping.

  • Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the oversight that regulated casework requires.

  • Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Malta, Romania or Canada, with fluency in English.

 

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

  • Hands-on use of a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize.

  • SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Experience drafting suspicious transaction and order reports or suspicious activity reports.

  • Electronic communications surveillance experience.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

Kraken Securities is the U.S. Broker Dealer entity of Kraken. The Senior Compliance Associate will support the existing CCO to ensure the Broker Dealer stays in compliance with all applicable FINRA, SEC and state regulations.

 

The opportunity

  • Assist in the execution of the Broker Dealer compliance and risk assessment programs. Compliance, testing, monitoring, surveillance and adherence to all other relevant and applicable laws and regulations.

  • Overseeing, addressing and remediating daily flags in KYC, CIP, Suitability, PEP, Sanctions while assisting in identifying policy and procedural enhancements and maintaining awareness of company goals, regulatory developments and industry trends while testing the effectiveness of controls.

  • Oversee and update the written supervisory procedures, surveillance program, testing programs, and the employee education programs including reviewing and addressing concerns from compliance testing results.

  • Monitor and challenge the reporting, escalation, and timely remediation of issues, deficiencies, or regulatory matters regarding compliance risk management. Complaint handling and monthly, quarterly and other ongoing reporting/ handling.

  • Prepare and coordinate with department leadership in creating the Annual CEO Certification report as specified in FINRA Rule 3130 as well other annual requirements.

  • Assists with assessment of external regulatory activity and changes in laws and regulations impacting Marketing.

  • Oversee the review of all marketing and sales material and communications (including social content). Administer and manage the compliance reviews of the electronic communications surveillance process to ensure the vendor platform is being used in an effective and efficient way as needed. Further ensuring all required written communications are being retained, from all sources used by the firm.

  • Support HR and other business departments by onboarding new hires and ensuring that questionnaires and attestations are obtained in a reasonable time frame. Performing required functions such as U-4, fingerprinting, disclosures, OBAs, PAD, onboarding training, etc.

  • Support compliance program enhancements in response to evolving regulatory requirements and business changes. Participating in firm responses to regulatory examinations, audits and inquiries.

 

What you bring

  • Series 7 and 24 qualifications and the ability to obtain others quickly.

  • Minimum of 5 years proven experience in a retail fintech Broker Dealer compliance department and working with regulators.

  • Comprehensive understanding of applicable laws, regulations and requirements, including industry practices.
