jobs.title: Senior Director of Product - P2P Marketplace & Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward’s Payments & Blockchain team builds the capabilities that move money into and out of its products, connecting banking partners, payment providers and local rails for millions of users.


We’re building a peer-to-peer marketplace for Asia-Pacific that lets users buy and sell digital assets directly with each other using familiar local payment methods. Payward will provide the marketplace infrastructure, merchant network, escrow, transaction management, and trust and safety capabilities.


We’re looking for an experienced product leader who has launched crypto P2P in APAC and can turn that expertise into a shared platform serving multiple Payward products.

The opportunity

  • Strategy and market expansion: Set the P2P vision, business objectives and roadmap. Prioritize markets, customer segments and payment methods based on demand, competitive conditions, economics and regulatory requirements.

  • Merchant network and liquidity: Develop the merchant acquisition, onboarding, incentives and retention strategy. Work with commercial and local teams to build dependable liquidity, competitive pricing and coverage across relevant payment methods.

  • Marketplace economics: Define fee structures and incentive programs. Set commercial targets and improve revenue, transaction costs and contribution margin with finance and commercial partners.

  • Core P2P capabilities: Lead product development across matching, escrow, order management, payment confirmation, transaction limits, merchant controls and dispute handling.

  • Platform adoption: Build reusable capabilities and integration requirements that allow multiple Payward products to offer P2P. Make the platform straightforward to integrate, operate and extend into new markets.

  • Buyer, seller and merchant requirements: Define transaction workflows, exception handling and acceptance criteria. Bring customer research and marketplace expertise into interface decisions, and use transaction data to identify friction and improve completion.

  • Trust and marketplace integrity: Partner with risk, compliance, legal and operations to build merchant verification, fraud prevention, dispute resolution and appeals into the product from the outset.

  • Launch and operating performance: Lead cross-functional launch planning and establish the processes needed to run each market. Track liquidity, order completion, time to trade, repeat usage, dispute rates, fraud losses and platform reliability.

  • Product leadership: Align senior stakeholders around priorities and tradeoffs, work closely with engineering on system capabilities, and develop product talent as the platform scales. Apply proven P2P playbooks and move quickly from decisions to live transactions.

What you bring

  • A demonstrated record of launching and scaling a crypto P2P marketplace in APAC, ideally including a launch from zero.

  • Senior product leadership experience with responsibility for strategy, roadmaps and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Deep understanding of merchant operations, two-sided liquidity, pricing, incentives and the economics of P2P trading.

  • Practical knowledge of APAC payment methods, local banking and wallet ecosystems, and how customer behavior differs across markets.

  • Experience building shared platform capabilities used by multiple products, channels or external partners.

  • Strong judgment about fraud, payment verification, transaction disputes and the operational realities of running a financial marketplace.

  • Technical fluency across APIs, transaction lifecycles, payment integrations and reliable financial systems.

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through partnerships with engineering, interface product teams, operations, risk and commercial teams.

Nice to haves

  • Experience expanding P2P across several APAC markets.

  • Experience with stablecoins and local fiat on/off-ramps.

  • Experience building and leading product teams.

  • Fluency in one or more APAC languages.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Dev Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's engineers build a lot of software. Developer Platform AI builds the AI systems they use to do it: agents that write and review code, simple access to the best models in the tools they already use, and the infrastructure that connects AI to our internal systems.

This is a small team with a lot of reach. The tools you ship will change how engineers across Kraken work every day, and you'll see that happen directly. The work spans agent platforms, code review, LLM routing and cost controls, MCP integrations with tools like Slack, Jira and GitLab, and the security and observability that make all of it safe to run.

If you want to work on applied AI with real users from day one, this is that job.

 


The Opportunity

  • LLM traffic doesn't behave like normal API traffic. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.

    • Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.

    • Design resilience across model providers: routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when a provider is slow, throttling or down.

    • Make LLM traffic legible. Build observability that shows latency, errors, token usage and cost by team, model and use case, so engineers can see what their workloads cost and where they're spending their time waiting.

    • Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.

    • Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.

    • Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.

    • Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.

    • Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.

    This is a Staff role. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform runs, not just keep it running. The platform is small enough that your decisions shape it directly, and used broadly enough that they affect every engineering team at Kraken.

Skills You Should HODL

  • Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code such as Terraform

  • Strong command of SLOs, observability and incident management, and the judgment to know which reliability work actually matters

  • Proficiency in Rust or Python, and comfort reading and changing a production service's code

  • Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

  • Experience operating multi-tenant internal platforms, including authentication, authorization and per-tenant cost controls

  • Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring other engineers with you


Nice to Haves

  • Experience operating LLM gateways or integrating LLM provider APIs at scale: streaming, token-based rate limiting, model routing and caching

  • Experience serving models yourself, including vLLM or Ray: GPU scheduling, batching, autoscaling and cost per token

  • Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators with controller-runtime or kubebuilder

  • Experience with Consul and Vault for service discovery, configuration and secrets

  • Experience with model evaluation pipelines for catching quality regressions before and after rollout

  • Familiarity with coding agents and agent harnesses, and running them safely in sandboxed environments

  • Experience with cost attribution, budgeting or FinOps for usage-based services

  • Background in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as financial services or crypto

  • Contributions to open-source gateway, proxy or observability projects

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Forget crypto. Fintech/crypto are now one of the same. Come join us to lead Product Design for the building of elite AI products, end-to-end. A personal finance agent that shapes how people spend, save invest and live.

 

You’ll have real ownership of the design work: the experiences you shape, and how they look, feel and behave. You’ll work directly with product, engineering and leadership, with no layers of process between you and the work.

 

This is a rare 0→1 opportunity. The choices you make will shape the products and the people who use them.

 

We’re a small, hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.

 

If you’re excited by hard problems, high standards, no egos and the chance to build something genuinely new, climb aboard.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Own design end to end: discovery, concept, prototyping, delivery and launch. You are the designer, with real ownership of the outcome.

  • Take products from zero to one, turning an early idea or a rough problem space into something real that people use.

  • Build new AI products for external B2C customers, and internal AI products that shape and redefine the way that Payward works.

  • Thrive in ambiguity. Define the problem, set the direction and make the call when nobody has handed you a brief.

  • Design for non-deterministic experiences, where outputs vary and the system doesn’t behave the same way twice. Shape how people interact with, understand and trust intelligent systems.

  • Create visually rich, forward-thinking work that sets new benchmarks for what AI products can look and feel like.

  • Partner directly with product, engineering and leadership, and influence strategy and roadmap decisions, not just execution.

  • Prototype fast to make ideas tangible, test them and learn, then move on to the next one.

  • Conduct user research and use customer insights, data and experimentation to decide what to build, and keep improving it after launch.

  • Hold a high bar for craft and user experience in everything you ship.

 

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft and impact.

  • A track record of taking products from zero to launch as the lead or only designer, owning the full design process end to end.

  • World class product thinking: Real comfort with ambiguity, you find direction when requirements are unclear, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and adapt as things change.

  • Experience designing for non-deterministic experiences, such as AI-powered, generative or probabilistic products, is highly desirable.

  • Strong UX and visual design skills, with a record of solving open-ended problems with clarity and elegance.

  • Advanced prototyping skills, with the ability to communicate complex interactions and ideas quickly.

  • Experience influencing product strategy and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to create coherent, scalable experiences from scratch.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Forget crypto. Fintech/crypto are now one of the same. Come join us to lead Product Design for the building of elite AI products, end-to-end. A personal finance agent that shapes how people spend, save invest and live.

 

You’ll have real ownership of the design work: the experiences you shape, and how they look, feel and behave. You’ll work directly with product, engineering and leadership, with no layers of process between you and the work.

 

This is a rare 0→1 opportunity. The choices you make will shape the products and the people who use them.

 

We’re a small, hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.

 

If you’re excited by hard problems, high standards, no egos and the chance to build something genuinely new, climb aboard.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Own design end to end: discovery, concept, prototyping, delivery and launch. You are the designer, with real ownership of the outcome.

  • Take products from zero to one, turning an early idea or a rough problem space into something real that people use.

  • Build new AI products for external B2C customers, and internal AI products that shape and redefine the way that Payward works.

  • Thrive in ambiguity. Define the problem, set the direction and make the call when nobody has handed you a brief.

  • Design for non-deterministic experiences, where outputs vary and the system doesn’t behave the same way twice. Shape how people interact with, understand and trust intelligent systems.

  • Create visually rich, forward-thinking work that sets new benchmarks for what AI products can look and feel like.

  • Partner directly with product, engineering and leadership, and influence strategy and roadmap decisions, not just execution.

  • Prototype fast to make ideas tangible, test them and learn, then move on to the next one.

  • Conduct user research and use customer insights, data and experimentation to decide what to build, and keep improving it after launch.

  • Hold a high bar for craft and user experience in everything you ship.

 

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft and impact.

  • A track record of taking products from zero to launch as the lead or only designer, owning the full design process end to end.

  • World class product thinking: Real comfort with ambiguity, you find direction when requirements are unclear, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and adapt as things change.

  • Experience designing for non-deterministic experiences, such as AI-powered, generative or probabilistic products, is highly desirable.

  • Strong UX and visual design skills, with a record of solving open-ended problems with clarity and elegance.

  • Advanced prototyping skills, with the ability to communicate complex interactions and ideas quickly.

  • Experience influencing product strategy and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to create coherent, scalable experiences from scratch.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst - Payward Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

As the first dedicated Sales Operations Analyst on the team, you’ll support Business Development across PWS and xStocks so our salespeople can spend their time selling. You’ll run RFP and DDQ responses from start to finish, prepare the team for diligence meetings, qualify and route inbound leads, and keep our CRM, pipeline reporting, and customer insights accurate. You’ll report to PWS sales leadership and work closely with Business Operations, Solutions, Legal, Compliance, and Product.

 

The opportunity

  • Own RFP and DDQ responses for PWS and xStocks from kickoff through submission: triage incoming questions, route technical and compliance items to Solutions and Compliance, and make sure answers are validated before they go out

  • Coordinate contributions from Legal, Compliance, Security, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams, establishing deadlines and driving follow-up to ensure timely, complete responses

  • Oversee document assembly and final formatting to ensure every submission is accurate, polished, and delivered on schedule

  • Lead internal preparation and alignment for major client presentations, particularly RFP due diligence meetings, and track action items through to resolution

  • Qualify inbound leads, including follow-up qualifying questions where needed, and route them promptly to the right salesperson or to self-serve onboarding

  • Maintain Attio CRM data integrity, ensuring accounts, contacts, deal stages, and client outreach activity are accurate and consistent with Salesforce and other teams’ systems

  • Build and maintain pipeline reporting in Attio, including stage definitions, funnel metrics, and forecast inputs, and prepare materials for weekly pipeline reviews

  • Manage the handoff from signed deal to onboarding, confirming contracts, pricing, and billing details are in place so Solutions and Finance can start without chasing information

  • Produce weekly customer insights from call notes and CRM activity, summarizing product requests, competitor feedback, and pricing feedback, and communicate emerging trends to Sales, Product, and leadership

  • Develop and maintain a library of approved RFP and DDQ responses, and use it with AI tools to draft accurate, consistent first-pass answers

  • Identify process gaps and implement better workflows, automating repetitive work where possible

  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

 

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in sales operations, sales support, or proposal management, ideally within banking, fintech, financial services, or crypto

  • Experience managing RFPs, DDQs, security or compliance questionnaires, or other complex documents with many contributors

  • Proven ability to drive deadlines and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Security, Product, and other teams

  • Hands-on experience with a CRM platform (Attio experience is a plus; Salesforce or HubSpot experience is transferable)

  • Comfort building simple reports and dashboards

  • Excellent writing, editing, and document formatting skills

  • Clear, confident communication with senior internal stakeholders and external clients

  • Understanding of institutional and B2B sales cycles in financial services

  • Interest in crypto and digital assets (prior industry experience is not required)

  • Proactive, process-oriented approach, with the ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions

  • Rigorous attention to detail

 

Nice to haves

  • Background in banking, institutional sales, or B2B infrastructure and API products

  • Familiarity with vendor due diligence and security questionnaires

  • Experience using AI tools or workflow automation to speed up repetitive sales or operations work

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Lead, Business Operations - Payward Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

As a Lead, Business Operations, you’ll be the operating generalist for PWS. Your core is partner launch and the operating rhythm behind the business, and from there you’ll take on whatever PWS needs to scale: launch readiness, operating cadence, reporting, and strategic projects with leadership. You’ll report to the head of PWS Business Operations and work with Sales, Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance, and the outcomes are yours. This is a builder role for someone who sees a broken process, fixes it, and keeps it running without being asked.

 

The opportunity

  • Act as the operating partner to PWS leadership: run the business cadence, including planning, goal-setting, business reviews, and leadership updates, and track the metrics that show how PWS is performing

  • Automate manual work across the business with AI and integrations, from partner launch checklists to reporting

  • Improve how partners launch, working with Solutions, Product, and Compliance to build a repeatable launch process and shorten time to go-live

  • Bring new products and acquired businesses onto the PWS operating rhythm

  • Lead strategic and cross-functional projects that don’t fit neatly into a single team but are critical to PWS’s success

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in BizOps, RevOps, Strategy, or similar roles, including in-house experience at a payments, fintech, financial services, or crypto company. Consulting experience is welcome alongside in-house work, not instead of it

  • A track record of owning a process end to end and driving it to done: you’ve taken something messy, built the system, and kept it running without anyone chasing you

  • Range: you’re as comfortable building a launch plan as you are automating a workflow, and you enjoy switching between them

  • A builder’s instinct: you’ve used AI tools, scripts, or no-code automation to remove manual work instead of waiting for someone else to

  • Clear communication across audiences: you can walk Sales through a new process, brief leadership on a decision, and write requirements Engineering can build from

  • Comfort with data and rigorous attention to detail

  • Self-starter who creates the roadmap when one doesn’t exist

 

Nice to haves

  • Background in payments, card programs, or crypto infrastructure

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As a Talent Acquisition Operations Associate, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition and Operations, you will help run the operations behind Payward’s global hiring engine. You will support the systems, processes, and coordination that keep hiring moving at pace, from interview operations and executive hiring to pre-boarding, background checks, and new hire setup in Workday. This role extends well beyond scheduling. It requires a strategic view of how a fast-growing, global company hires, along with precision, discretion, and sound judgment.

You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and executive assistants to support scheduling, anticipate bottlenecks, and keep stakeholders aligned at every stage. You will work heavily in our recruiting tools, keeping candidate and hiring data accurate and up to date across regions.

This is a 6-month fixed-term position supporting US timezones.

The opportunity

  • Own interview operations end to end, partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates across regions and time zones to deliver a seamless candidate experience

  • Support global executive and non-executive hiring operations, including scheduling and rescheduling, tracking and candidate communications

  • Partner with executive assistants across regions to coordinate calendars and keep hiring timelines on track

  • Own pre-boarding for new hires worldwide, including country-specific background check requirements and communications, tracking progress, resolving issues, and flagging risks to start dates early

  • Create and maintain accurate candidate and hiring records in Ashby and Workday, and ensure new hire data is complete and timely for hires in every region

  • Partner with onboarding, recruiting, and hiring managers to create a seamless transition from offer acceptance to day one

  • Apply our hiring policies accurately and consistently across regions, flagging exceptions and escalating early

What you bring

  • 4+ years in recruiting coordination, talent acquisition operations, HR operations, or a similar role, ideally in a high-growth, global environment spanning NORAM, EMEA, LATAM, APAC and MENA

  • Hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS, and familiarity with applicant tracking systems (Ashby a plus)

  • Experience supporting pre-boarding and onboarding, including coordinating background checks, tracking progress, resolving issues, and flagging risks to start dates early

  • Working knowledge of background check processes and requirements across multiple countries and regions

  • Comfort coordinating across time zones, with the ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and logistics with exceptional precision and no missed details

  • Exceptional judgment and discretion in handling confidential candidate and executive information

  • Excellent communication skills and the professionalism to work comfortably with executives, hiring managers, and candidates from diverse regions and cultures

  • The ability to prioritize competing deadlines and adapt quickly

Nice to have

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – AI Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The AI Infrastructure team builds and operates the production systems that power intelligent agents at scale. This team sits at the foundation of the agent platform, ensuring that model inference, orchestration, and execution layers are reliable, observable, and performant under real-world load.

Working closely with the Agent Systems team and broader infrastructure partners, this group owns the core primitives that enable agents to safely operate across internal systems. The environment is high-scale and high-stakes — systems serve millions of users and must meet strict reliability, latency, and correctness standards.

This is a deeply production-oriented team. Engineers here combine strong systems thinking with applied ML infrastructure experience, building in Rust and operating services where performance and failure modes matter.

 

The opportunity

  • Design and build the infrastructure layer powering AI agent systems in production

  • Develop high-performance services that handle model inference, orchestration, and execution

  • Architect scalable systems capable of supporting millions of users and high request throughput

  • Build reliable ML infrastructure and MLOps patterns for model deployment, evaluation, and monitoring

  • Define guardrails, observability, and failure handling for agent-driven workflows

  • Optimize latency, throughput, and cost across inference and orchestration layers

  • Partner closely with the Agent Systems team to translate experimental prototypes into hardened production systems

  • Contribute to foundational infrastructure decisions in a high-scale, high-impact environment

 

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating high-scale production systems

  • Strong Python skills and the ability to reason about systems performance and reliability

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, reliability engineering, and performance optimization

  • Experience operating services serving millions of users or high-throughput workloads

  • Familiarity with ML infrastructure, model serving, or MLOps in production environments

  • Experience designing observability, monitoring, and failure recovery systems

  • Strong collaboration skills working across infrastructure and applied engineering teams

  • High ownership mindset in high-stakes production environment

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Rust

  • Experience building infrastructure for agent-based or LLM-powered systems

  • Background in high-performance networking, async systems, or low-latency architectures

  • Experience with container orchestration and cloud-native infrastructure

  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks and model performance monitoring at scale

  • Experience working in fast-moving 0→1 or platform-building teams

Kraken’s Core Infrastructure Engineering team builds and operates the shared data systems behind critical production services. Our estate spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, with MariaDB at its centre and Kafka, Redis and Elasticsearch across the wider platform.

We’re hiring a Principal Database Engineer to bring long-term experience and technical judgment to this estate. You’ll assess it, set the goals and direction, and work hands-on with the team to deliver measurable improvements. This is an individual contributor role with influence across teams and several quarters of work.

 

The opportunity

  • Review the estate against business needs and production evidence. Judge reliability, scale, cost and operational complexity, identifying what should be preserved and where investment or simplification would make a difference.

  • Define the target architecture and measurable goals. Agree a prioritised roadmap with engineering leads and dependent teams, explaining the trade-offs and sequencing work around delivery risks.

  • Execute that roadmap with the team through design, implementation and adoption. Stay personally involved in difficult migrations and scaling decisions, with representative benchmarks, data-integrity checks and credible cutover and rollback plans. Adapt the plan as evidence changes and verify the results in production before calling the work complete.

  • Investigate difficult MariaDB failures and performance limits through the engine, storage and application behaviour. Improve fleet reliability through useful observability, safer changes and tested backup, restore and disaster recovery procedures. Set recovery objectives with service owners and prove them through exercises.

  • Build and maintain production software for database provisioning, upgrades and routine maintenance. Make self-service workflows safe and auditable, incorporating access controls and change evidence with Security and Compliance.

  • Work with application teams on schemas, transaction boundaries, queries and data-store choices. Make the operational consequences clear and resolve dependencies that span teams.

  • Mentor engineers across the team through design reviews, pairing and incident analysis. Help them deepen their database expertise and take ownership of technical decisions.

  • Participate in on-call and incident response, leaving clear operational ownership and following through on lessons from production.

 

What you bring

  • 8+ years operating and evolving production database estates at scale. You have assessed inherited systems, set technical direction and delivered improvements with engineering teams, and can explain how those decisions held up over time.

  • Strong understanding of high availability, replication and distributed database failure modes. You can explain consistency and availability trade-offs and reason about transaction boundaries and reliable event delivery, including transactional outbox patterns.

  • Deep, recent hands-on MariaDB expertise, including InnoDB, MVCC and transaction isolation, locking, query optimisation, binary logs and MariaDB GTID replication. You can explain the mechanisms and diagnostic evidence behind your decisions.

  • Personal ownership of MariaDB incident diagnosis, performance tuning and tested restore or point-in-time recovery. You can explain what you did, how you established data integrity and what remained uncertain.

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, Rust or a comparable language. You have personally built and maintained production software or automation for database workflows such as provisioning, failover, online schema changes and self-service operations, using version control, code review and delivery pipelines, with tested failure handling.

  • Strong low-level Linux, Kernel, storage and networking fundamentals, with the ability to investigate problems beyond the database process.

  • Clear written technical judgment and demonstrated delivery across teams without reporting-line authority. You help stakeholders make sound database design and lifecycle decisions, and develop experienced engineers through shared delivery.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience operating databases in containerised, hybrid on-premises/cloud or multi-region environments. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or GitOps, including their operational trade-offs.

  • Experience with database proxies or load-balancing layers (MaxScale, HAProxy, ProxySQL, or similar).

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Vitess, TiDB, ScyllaDB, ClickHouse or internal database platforms; operational knowledge of Kafka, Redis/Valkey or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Experience in regulated environments or contributions to database engines, operators and other infrastructure software.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. jobs.title: Software Engineer - DevOps - Bitnomial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Bitnomial is building the next generation US-based global derivatives exchange, starting with digital assets and progressively expanding to encompass a full spectrum of commodities worldwide. Bitnomial operates a US CFTC regulated exchange (DCM), clearinghouse (DCO), and brokerage (FCM). It offers a range of crypto-settled derivatives, including futures, options, and a suite of live perpetual futures, used by brokers, hedge funds, institutions, and trading firms around the world.

Bitnomial's exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage systems are written largely in Haskell. In this role you will build the services and data models that record every order, fill, and settlement at a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse, with the database as a first-class part of the design. You will build features across these systems and design the schema, queries, and migrations behind them.

 

The opportunity

  • Improve build and release pipelines in GitHub Actions: caching, parallelism, pinned toolchains, and required tests and scans before production

  • Manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform, and run services as containers on Nomad

  • Build deployment tooling with health checks and automated rollback, and make deploys safe around market sessions

  • Add metrics and alerts to the services you build, so you can see whether a deploy worked

  • Monitor systems, respond to alerts, and support daily operations such as settlement cycles

  • Fix the cause of production issues and write down what you learned

  • Build, test, and ship well-reviewed features and fixes in our services across the exchange, clearinghouse, and brokerage. Most of the code is Haskell

  • Understand the order, trade, clearing, and settlement flows end to end

 

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI

  • Production experience with AWS and Docker, and infrastructure as code with Terraform

  • Strong Linux and scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a functional or strongly typed programming language such as Haskell, Rust, or C++

  • Solid computer science fundamentals, including distributed systems: failure modes, retries and idempotency, consistency, and how to observe them across services

  • Willingness to take part in on-call and operational shifts

  • Care and rigor with code that moves money

  • Good judgment with AI tools. You use them to work faster, and you read, test, and understand what they produce before you ship it

  • A habit of asking why before changing something

  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a calm and methodical approach when production is live

  • Collaboration across engineering, operations, risk, and compliance, with a habit of documenting

 

Nice to haves

  • Financial knowledge or experience in trading, markets, or financial services

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience with Nomad or Kubernetes

  • Experience with Nix, Ansible, Vault, or Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki

  • Haskell experience

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Haskell experience, particularly with PostgreSQL-backed services

  • Production experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL

  • Experience with time series or market data at volume, such as tick data, order books, or event streams

  • Experience with Atlas or another declarative schema management tool
